name: Imprenta siglo xv
creator: Daniel.Marquez2 (@Daniel.Marquez2)
modifications: Re-encoded with EXT_meshopt_compression; textures resized to 1024 px WebP.
educationalRole: Discovery → আবিষ্কার ও আবিষ্কারক → ছাপাখানা: a low-poly reconstruction of a 15th-century Gutenberg-style wooden screw press, modelled from schematics of early Renaissance presses.
limitations: A stylised reconstruction, not a scan of a surviving press; no original Gutenberg press survives.
Movable type and ink balls are not modelled.
